title: Organization structure
description: Build each company's structure with three forms: levels, then units, then job titles.
selectUnit: Select a unit in the tree to see its details.

empty.title: This company has no units yet
empty.description: Start by adding the first unit at the top level. You can review the levels (sector, department, section, unit) first with the “Levels” button.

levels.title: Levels of the structure
levels.description: Order the levels from top to bottom. The last level accepts job titles and employees.
levels.rules: Enter both names for every level; the last level must accept employees.

impact.title: This change affects existing data
impact.description: Review what will be removed before confirming. Nothing changes until you confirm.
impact.summary: Will be removed: {{units}} unit(s) and {{titles}} job title(s). Employees attached: {{employees}}.
impact.employeesQuestion: What happens to the attached employees ({{count}})?
impact.deleteWarning: {{count}} employees will be deleted, their accounts disabled and their sessions ended.
impact.typeCount: Type the number of employees to confirm

node.title: Add unit
node.description: Choose the level, then the parent unit from the level above.
node.managerHint: Optional. Proposed as the direct manager of the unit's employees.
node.startHint: The day the unit started working.
node.startInvalid: Not a sensible date: from 1980 up to two years ahead.

titles.title: Add job titles
titles.description: Add one or more titles to a unit that accepts employees.
titles.templateHint: The role of this title starts with the permissions of this role; you can edit them later on the roles page.

move.title: Move unit
move.description: Choose another unit from the level above this one.

details.deleteBody: The unit and its job titles are deleted if it has no sub-units or employees.
details.deleteTitleBody: A title with employees, or the last title of a unit, cannot be deleted.

chart.searchPlaceholder: Find a unit in the chart
chart.label: Organization chart of {{company}}

table.title: Units ({{count}})
table.name: Unit
table.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, path or manager

org.title: Organization
org.body: The company tree with its sectors, departments, sections and units, each with its manager and headcount. Switch between the chart and the table to see the view that suits you, and search to reach any unit.

can.unit_create: Add a new unit to the structure
can.unit_update: Edit a unit and its manager
can.unit_move: Move a unit elsewhere in the tree
can.levels: Manage the levels of the structure
can.export: Export the structure to a file

org-views.title: Ways to view the structure
org-views.body: Switch between three views: the chart is a tree of colored cards, the icicle is side-by-side blocks, and the table lists every unit. The divisions are the levels of the structure (sector, department, section, unit); each level has a fixed color shown in the legend above the chart. Click any unit to see its manager, employees and job titles.

org-levels.title: Structure levels
org-levels.body: Here you set the levels of the structure, their names and order; every unit belongs to one of them. A change here shows across the company.

can.titles: You add job titles to your units with the "Add job title" button

org-add-unit.title: Add a unit
org-add-unit.body: Click here to add a unit: write its name in Arabic and English, choose its level, then the parent unit it belongs to, its manager and its job titles, and save so it appears in the chart. In the table view a "+" button on each row adds a unit directly under it.

can.unit_update: You edit any unit and its manager with the pencil on its row
can.unit_move: You move a unit under another parent with the move button
